sources.text: Scientists think they've found ancient remnants of dinosaur blood
sources.highlight: Scientists think they've found ancient remnants of dinosaur blood

sources.title: Mice can learn to fight by watching tiny rodent cage matches, study finds
sources.text: Mice can learn to fight by watching tiny rodent cage matches, study finds
sources.highlight: Mice can learn to fight by watching tiny rodent cage matches, study finds
sources.after: Brain scientists set up "gladiator style" cage matches for mice — and found that simply observing fighting matches can rewire a mouse's brain to resemble those who actually fought.
